findings.title: right_angle passes a 90-degree copper corner whose 45-degree chamfer is shorter than half the track width, on every non-critical net
findings.contradicts: REQUIREMENTS M2 / AGENTS section 3 (D-R24-17): every bend 45 degrees, 'no 90 deg bend in open copper'; M2 'What the gate enforces': route_check fails the board 'on every net' on any 90-degree bend. route_check's own right_angle test judges the copper's inner corner (N + h_b u_a + h_a u_b) at pads and vias. D-R24-17 states a chamfer is never under max(width, 0.2 mm) (the generator fails such a bend).
findings.evidence: Seed D2b (.supervisor/r24_gate/seeds/D2b_short_chamfers_noncritical, scripts/seed_d2b.py): existing chamfers re-cut shorter, as dragging a leg toward its corner in KiCad's router or a hand-entered cut does. Three keep an exactly square inner corner: SERVO2_MCU B.Cu corner (30.55, 71.85), BAT_FAULT_N F.Cu (16.55, 83.35) and NRST B.Cu (22.54, 36.239), each 0.2 mm wide with a 0.05 mm per-axis cut (0.071 mm diagonal). With corner N, leg directions u_a, u_c and h = w/2, the chamfer's copper reaches the plain bend's inner corner N + h(u_a + u_c) only when the cut d >= (2 - sqrt2) h = 0.0586 mm; at 0.05 mm it is (2h - d)/sqrt2 = 0.106 mm > h from it. Probe (scripts/corner_probe.py, out/D2b_corner_probe.json): the point 2 um inside the corner is copper and the point 2 um into the notch is not, for all three (on 1407e850 the corner point is bare: chamfered). route_check --profile r10 on D2b: 'routing hygiene: 0 failing, 0 allowlisted ... (10 unrecorded ...)' (5 on 1407e850), exit 0, right_angle 0; the cuts appear only as ungated short_segment leftovers (classes actuator / other). kicad-cli DRC (severity all, parity) on the same edits (seed D2): 0 / 0 / 0. check_r10 on D2b fails only K-binding and F9-1, the hash bindings every board change refreshes. Control (seed D2): the same 0.05 mm cut on SD_SCK (spi) and a 0.4 mm cut on the 1.0 mm BAT_IN (power) fail as short_segment, because short_segment is gated on critical nets only.
findings.impact: A 90-degree copper bend on any non-critical net (servo, NRST, status lines) passes check.sh after a KiCad drag or a hand-entered cut, though M2 says the gate fails 90-degree bends on every net; the owner's rule is then held only by review.
findings.concrete_fix: In route_check's node pass, also flag right_angle when a 45-degree segment joins two perpendicular legs (meeting each at 135 degrees at plain nodes) and leaves the plain bend's inner corner outside its copper (per-axis cut under (2 - sqrt2) x half the width), or, matching the generator floor, is shorter than max(width, 0.2 mm), on every net; add a seeded case to RouteCheck.test_r24_right_angle (a 0.05 mm cut on a 0.2 mm non-critical bend fails, the 0.36 mm fixed cut passes).

findings.title: No check holds the short-edge 2.5 mm component clearance D-R24-15 restored: R92 / TP88 moved back to the forward edge pass every gate
findings.contradicts: JLC assembly terms section 2.3 as cited in docs/ORDERING.md section 8.1 ('require 2.5 mm from a component body to the board edge'); ORDERING 8.1 / R10_VALIDATION row 27 / D-R24-15 list only C95, R166, R400, R401, R404 and C403 as expected short-edge DFM queries and state R92 and TP88 courtyards >= 2.5 mm.
findings.evidence: Seed F1 (seeds/F1_r92_tp88_back, scripts/seed_edge.py): R92 F(31, 86.7) -> F(31, 87.5) and TP88 F(35.5, 86.4) -> F(35.5, 87.0), their RAW_PROTECTED / GND tracks and GND vias (32.65, 86.7) -> (32.65, 87.5), (36.6, 86.4) -> (36.6, 87.0) moved with them (the 5516eeec placement, a revert of the two r10_place.tsv / r10_fanout.tsv rows), zones refilled. Courtyard to the forward edge: R92 about 1.72 mm, TP88 about 1.95 mm. kicad-cli DRC severity all with parity: 0 violations, 0 unconnected, 0 parity. route_check --profile r10: 0 failing, exit 0. fit_check OK. check_r10: only K-binding and F9-1 fail (the hash-bound binding note and hot-plug inputs, F9-1 naming R92 as a model input; both are regenerated by r10_build.sh, and 5516eeec, with R92 at F(31, 87.5), passed the 2304-case model: Inference that the rebuilt model passes). No rule in check_r10, fit_check, silk_check, verify_board or T-1 measures component-to-short-edge distance (grep; T-1 covers the long-edge tab bands only). On 1407e850 the parts under 2.5 mm are exactly the six recorded (R400 / R401 / R404 1.025, C403 1.955 aft; C95 1.505, R166 1.755 forward; courtyard, scripts/inspect2.py).
findings.impact: A placement revert or a KiCad move puts a part inside JLC's 2.5 mm short-edge band without a DFM-query record; the records then state R92 / TP88 >= 2.5 mm falsely and the order remark omits the part.
findings.concrete_fix: Add a check_r10 rule (e.g. in M-6 or T-1): every footprint courtyard >= 2.5 mm from the rail-less short edges (y = 0 and y = 90) unless it is an exact SHORT_EDGE_QUERIES entry (C95, R166, R400, R401, R404, C403 with their measured distances), a stale or grown entry failing; seed it with R92 at F(31, 87.5).

findings.title: BOOT0's second via is cited as D-R24-05 (U9's EN, kept single) in the gate and generator; it is D-R24-03
findings.contradicts: R10_DECISIONS.md: D-R24-03 'BOOT0's second via'; D-R24-05 'U9's EN pull-down stays across one via'. docs/M3_R10.md line 41 and R10_VALIDATION line 1995 cite D-R24-03 for BOOT0.
findings.evidence: tools/route_check.py line 342, PARALLEL_VIAS_R10 BOOT0 (14.2, 46.0) reason 'D-R24-05 (R23-MCU-02): BOOT0's pull-down R5 ...' (the measured reason route_check reports for the named via); m3_design/r10_route_core.py line 108 boot0() docstring 'D-R24-05 (R23-MCU-02, D-R23-01): a second BOOT0 barrel'; tools/check_r10.py line 3038 'D-R24-04 / -05 give VCAP2 (U1.73) and BOOT0 (U1.94) a second via'; tools/test_r10_check.py lines 4466 and 4934 the same list. No code cites D-R24-03.
findings.impact: The exception reason and generator record for the BOOT0 barrel point at the U9 EN decision, which says the opposite (a single via kept); a reviewer checking the barrel's provenance reads the wrong record.
findings.concrete_fix: Replace D-R24-05 with D-R24-03 at route_check.py:342, r10_route_core.py:108, check_r10.py:3038 ('D-R24-03 / -04') and test_r10_check.py:4466 / 4934 (comments; no behaviour change).

observations: Stale-exception logic fires correctly: each of the 11 SINGLE_OPEN_EXCEPTIONS entries D-R24 removed, restored on 1407e850, fails as 'stale SINGLE_OPEN_EXCEPTIONS entry'; on the matching dropped-second-via seed the restored entry is used again and the failure clears (U402.2 / R430.2 each need their own entry) (out/B_restored_exceptions.txt).

single_via_opens reports an unused entry as stale only when its tap pad exists and is in SINGLE_OPEN_TAPS; an entry for a removed tap is silently ignored. This needs a checker edit, not a board defect, so it is not a gate miss.
Dropping GND (32.3, 60.1)'s B.Cu link alone (seed A10) passes: the via stays joined to U402's island through the B.Cu fill, so the redundancy is real; K-power counts fills.
K-binding and F9-1 fail on every board copy (hash-bound records), whatever the change; r10_build.sh regenerates them, so seeds were judged on the other rules.

m3_design/check_actuators.py line 576: the r10 profile's failure text reads 'J1.3 only through R80 to BAT_IN' although the r10 check is on J400.1 (an R9 pin name in a message; the check itself is correct, seed C2 BAT_SW_SOURCE).

First D402 'fed beyond R165' seed (C4) shorted BAT_SW_RETURN into other copper and was discarded; the replacement C4b (tap from a via at R165.1, one tracks_crossing DRC item with BAT_SW_SOURCE, not on the judged net) fails K-ports 'reached only through R165'.

On 5516eeec (9b27268) the current route_check finds the 59 right_angle instances D-R24-17 states (F.Cu 24 free + 1 via; B.Cu 26 free + 3 via + 2 pad; In2 3 free), so the pad / via inner-corner test catches the pre-pass pad and via bends.

The generator's floor (no chamfer under max(width, 0.2 mm), D-R24-17) is not a board gate either: seeded 0.127 / 0.170 mm chamfers on SERVO3_MCU / BUZZ_OUT also pass, but their copper does cover the inner corner, so only the sub-0.0586 mm cuts are counted in R24-GATE-01.
